name: Dhenu Buildcon Infra Limited
about: Dhenu Buildcon Infra Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the business of investment, financing, and trading in shares and securities in India. The company was formerly known as The Hingir Rampur Coal Company Limited and changed its name to Dhenu Buildcon Infra Limited in September 2012. Dhenu Buildcon Infra Limited was incorporated in 1909 and is based in Mumbai, India.
